zh: 兰卡斯特大学（Lancaster University）成立于1964年，位于英国英格兰兰开夏郡兰卡斯特市，是一所世界知名的公立研究型大学，也是平板玻璃大学与N8大学联盟成员。学校以高质量教学、高水平科研与良好的学生体验著称，在英国本土教学评估与科研评估中常年位居前列。兰卡斯特大学在管理学、经济学、语言学、心理学、环境科学、工程学等领域实力突出，其商学院是获得AACSB、EQUIS、AMBA三重认证的世界顶尖商学院之一。学校采用学院制社区模式，注重跨学科交流与实践能力培养，校园环境优美、学术氛围浓厚，与全球众多高校和企业建立了稳定的合作关系，为学生提供丰富的国际交流与实习机会。
en: Lancaster University was founded in 1964 and is located in Lancaster, Lancashire, England, UK. It is a world-renowned public research university and a member of the Plate Glass Universities and the N8 Research Partnership. The university is famous for its high-quality teaching, outstanding research performance and excellent student experience, and consistently ranks among the top in UK teaching and research assessments. Lancaster University excels in management, economics, linguistics, psychology, environmental science, engineering and other fields. Its Business School is one of the world's top business schools with triple accreditation from AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA. Adopting a collegiate system, the university emphasizes interdisciplinary communication and practical ability training. With a beautiful campus and strong academic atmosphere, it has established stable cooperative relations with many universities and enterprises around the world, providing students with abundant international exchange and internship opportunities.
